traps.label: Tonight at GYM Bar — Wed Sep 9 4:00pm (page 1 rows 0–2, dated before the recon date)

openQuestions.q: The bulk of the feed is venue-open rows ("Tonight at GYM Bar" daily, "Tonight at Ty's" daily, "Monday/Tuesday/Thursday/Friday/Saturday at The Eagle NYC") tagged bears by the editor. They are documented as published events; whether they count as events for the calendar is the bear/editorial pass's call, not this recon's.

Run 20260909-072307 attributed "Bear Cave Friday at The 244 Spot" (feed place: The 244 Spot, South Amboy NJ) and "Saturday Night Karaoke at GYM Bar" (feed place: Gym Sportsbar) to bar "Eagle NYC". The feed carries the correct place and address on every row, so this is a scraper-side venue merge, not a source ambiguity.

The 2026-09-18 22:00 Nowhere row (uid 41438, kind "mod") is titled "Fat Bunny at Nowhere" on the recon date, while run 20260909-072307 extracted it as "Fat Fuc at Nowhere" (the uid's usual title). The editor retitled the instance between the two reads; a title-keyed diff will see a miss plus a phantom.

The ICS export stamps the two 2026-10-31 22:00 rows one hour earlier than the JSON feed (DST ends 2026-11-01). Which wall clock the venue actually uses that night is unverified; the JSON value (22:00 local) is what the site renders.
